head: TruePrompter: teleprompter app that floats over your camera, $9.99
dek: TruePrompter shows your script on top of the camera or any other app on iPhone and iPad and scrolls along as you speak. It costs $9.99 once, with no subscription, and was #76 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 16 November.
details: Speech recognition runs on the device, and the maker says scripts, recordings and your voice stay on it. You can import scripts from Word, PDF, RTF or text files, blur or replace the background, trim and split clips and add captions. An Apple Watch, another phone or computer on Wi-Fi, or a Bluetooth clicker or keyboard can work as a remote. An AI script helper needs Apple Intelligence.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), $9.99 on the App Store, Family Sharing for up to six people
means: If you record videos for TikTok, YouTube or work calls, you can read a script while looking at the camera without a separate prompter rig.
todo: Check that your iPhone runs iOS 17 or later before you buy; the AI script feature only works on devices with Apple Intelligence.
